verdict.rationale: Sentry has a first-party documentation page titled "Server-Side Data Scrubbing" under its security/PII docs, which covers the server-side half of the story. The pack gives only the title, with no detail on rule types or behavior. Nothing in the evidence shows SDK-level filtering of PII before events are sent. Missing for 10: SDK-level filtering/beforeSend-style scrubbing evidence, detail on server-side scrubbing rules, confirmation that data is scrubbed before it persists, independent or hands-on corroboration.
